title: Neon Dynasty Commander: card flavor text

entities.name: Saiba Futurists
entities.description: A Kamigawa faction of inventors that guards secret experiments with defensive technology and extracts data and rivals' secrets.

entities.name: Arima
entities.description: Lead inventor of the Futurists, who says technology evolves faster than a blade can swing.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: An Imperial advisor who urges mourning and remembering the dead.

entities.name: Yoshimaru, Ever Faithful
entities.description: A loyal figure who waits daily, knowing the Wanderer will return for him.

entities.name: the Wanderer
entities.description: A figure Yoshimaru expects to return for him.

entities.name: Kotori, Pilot Prodigy
entities.description: A pilot who prefers to demolish limits.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: A Kaladesh authority that recruits pilots from the League of Aeronauts and demands mass-production standards.

entities.name: League of Aeronauts
entities.description: A group of pilots from which the Consulate recruits.

entities.name: Axgard
entities.description: An impregnable underground kingdom of dwarves.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A mage who wonders if a teleportation spell to oblivion is still teleportation.

entities.name: Auriok
entities.description: A people who see the artificer as a conduit and hold a proverb of angelic blades.

entities.name: Sram, Senior Edificer
entities.description: An edificer worried that the city's machinery cannot stay balanced as conflict grows.

entities.name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
entities.description: A figure who believes the Ancestor saved them for a purpose.

entities.name: the Ancestor
entities.description: A being who saved Teshar's people for a purpose.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: A people who see the artificer as an archaeologist.

entities.name: Sai, Master Thopterist
entities.description: A thopterist who says industry without artistry fills the junkyard.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: A people who see only what things can teach, and know no art.

entities.name: Nundari
entities.description: A Sea Gate militia captain who describes training for the improbable.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A city with a militia captained by Nundari.

entities.name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
entities.description: A goblin who speaks of grabbing time after people flee and before the enemy arrives.

entities.name: Euphemia
entities.description: A Nexus watcher who says monsters dwell in every heart.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker who holds that life is conflict and only the strong survive.

entities.name: Shigeki
entities.description: A Jukai visionary who says the soul of Jukai reaches beyond the forest.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: A forest whose soul reaches far beyond its edge.

entities.name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
entities.description: A Kaladesh renegade who believes aether should be free.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: A plane whose soul is aether.

entities.name: Kaldrin
entities.description: A jungle sightseer who asks where the birds went.

entities.name: Nayans
entities.description: A people who dare not hunt the gargantuans.

entities.name: Grumgully, the Generous
entities.description: A figure who urges others to take gifts gratefully.

entities.name: Hanna, Ship's Navigator
entities.description: A navigator who says she is a maker, not a destroyer.

entities.name: Kresh the Bloodbraided
entities.description: A warrior who says any sword will do for a strong wielder.

entities.name: Domri
entities.description: A planeswalker whose ascent some view as a sign of Ilharg's return.

entities.name: Ilharg the Raze-Boar
entities.description: A creature whose return some believe Domri's ascent signals.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A guild associated with anarchy.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A planeswalker who wields the Blackblade Reforged.

entities.name: Blackblade Reforged
entities.description: A sword that spilled the blood of one elder dragon and may taste another's in Gideon's hands.

entities.name: Mairsil, the Pretender
entities.description: A figure who asks what others have that he cannot obtain.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker who denounces the Peacewalker Colossus as made only for fear.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Enemies evaded by the Shimmer Myr.

entities.name: Myr
entities.description: Artificial creatures regarded as omens, toys, and hiding from Phyrexians.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: A people who thought of the myr as omens.

entities.name: Kenjek
entities.description: Captain of the Thousand Swords who praises rushing into combat when prepared.

entities.name: Pulan
entities.description: A Bant orchardist who recounts trees transformed overnight.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A volcanic continent with gas-vent vegetation and jagged peaks.

entities.name: Ganzan Pass
entities.description: Site of a battle that saturated the land with blood and twisted kami magic.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A region whose coastal cities are shrouded by the haunted fog Nebelgast.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: A continent that is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and rivers.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: A soaring city that moves over Kamigawa with a purpose few understand.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane over which Otawara moves.

entities.name: Magic Mirror
entities.description: An artifact that crystallized a drop of water into the Arcane Signet.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: A guild whose mage loses her thermoinverter.

events.summary: Arima states technology outpaces blades.
events.quote: Technology evolves faster than a blade can swing.

events.summary: Light-Paws counsels remembering the dead.
events.quote: Mourn them, envy them, but above all, remember them.

events.summary: The Saiba Futurists guard secret experiments with defensive networks.
events.quote: The Saiba Futurists guard their secret experiments with ever-evolving networks of cutting-edge defensive technology.

events.summary: The Futurists supplement research with rivals' secrets.
events.quote: The Futurists eagerly supplement their research with their rivals' closely guarded secrets.

events.summary: Few outside the Futurists know the extent of their data-extraction network.
events.quote: Few outside the Saiba Futurists know the true extent of their data-extraction network.

events.summary: Yoshimaru waits daily, expecting the Wanderer to return for him.
events.quote: Day after day he sat there, knowing that the Wanderer would soon be back for him.

events.summary: Kotori prefers demolishing limits.
events.quote: Some people test limits. I prefer to demolish them.

events.summary: The Consulate recruits pilots from the League of Aeronauts, many of whom command fleets.
events.quote: The Consulate recruits its best pilots from the League of Aeronauts. Many go on to command entire fleets.

events.summary: Dwarves of Axgard leave their kingdom only in force.
events.quote: The dwarves of Axgard seldom have reason to leave their impregnable underground kingdom—but when they do, they go in force.

events.summary: Venser wonders whether teleporting to oblivion is teleportation.
events.quote: Venser wondered if it could still be called a teleportation spell if the destination is oblivion.

events.summary: Sram worries about keeping the city's machinery balanced as conflict grows.
events.quote: As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down.

events.summary: Teshar believes the Ancestor saved them for a purpose.
events.quote: The Ancestor saved us for a purpose.

events.summary: Sai says industry needs artistry.
events.quote: Industry without artistry is just a fancy way to fill the junkyard.

events.summary: Nundari describes the militia training for improbable events.
events.quote: We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once.

events.summary: Krenko describes the moment between people fleeing and the enemy arriving.
events.quote: After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time.

events.summary: Survivors of a disaster view the sky with dread.
events.quote: Ever since the disaster, the city's survivors viewed the star-strewn sky with dread.

events.summary: Euphemia says monsters dwell in every heart.
events.quote: Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them.

events.summary: Garruk states that life is conflict.
events.quote: The predator knows the true way of the world. Life is conflict. Only the strong survive.

events.summary: Shigeki says the soul of Jukai reaches beyond the forest.
events.quote: The soul of Jukai reaches far beyond the forest's edge.

events.summary: Rishkar declares aether the soul of Kaladesh and that souls should be free.
events.quote: Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free.

events.summary: Few Nayans dare hunt gargantuans.
events.quote: Few Nayans dare hunt the gargantuans.

events.summary: Kaldrin asks where the birds went.
events.quote: Where'd all the birds go?

events.summary: Hanna says she is a maker, not a destroyer.
events.quote: I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer.

events.summary: Kresh says any sword suffices for a strong wielder.
events.quote: When the wielder is strong enough, any sword will do.

events.summary: Some view Domri's ascent as a sign of Ilharg's return.
events.quote: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.

events.summary: The Blackblade Reforged spilled an elder dragon's blood and may taste another's in Gideon's hands.
events.quote: It spilled the blood of one elder dragon. In Gideon's hands, it may yet taste another's.

events.summary: Mairsil challenges what others could have that he cannot obtain.
events.quote: What do you have that I cannot obtain?

events.summary: Saheeli Rai calls the Peacewalker Colossus a tool of fear.
events.quote: Peace? Its sole purpose is fear.

events.summary: The Shimmer Myr evades Phyrexians by hiding between seconds.
events.quote: It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.

events.summary: The leonin viewed myr as omens of a sinister fate.
events.quote: The leonin thought of the myr as omens, never imagining the sinister fate they foretold.

events.summary: The vedalken saw the myr as toys, unaware of their intelligence.
events.quote: The vedalken saw the myr as toys, unaware of the intelligence lurking behind their empty eyes.

events.summary: The battle at Ganzan Pass left the land barren for a century.
events.quote: The battle at Ganzan Pass left the land so saturated with blood and twisted kami magic that it was a century before a single blade of grass could take root.

events.summary: Otawara moves over Kamigawa with a purpose few understand.
events.quote: the soaring city of Otawara moves over Kamigawa with a purpose that few understand.

events.summary: Pulan recounts trees transformed overnight.
events.quote: When we awoke, we found our trees transformed.

events.summary: Kenjek advises preparation before charging into combat.
events.quote: There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared.

relations.note: Arima is lead inventor of the Futurists.
relations.quote: Technology evolves faster than a blade can swing.

relations.note: Teshar is the Ancestor's apostle and believes in being saved by them.
relations.quote: The Ancestor saved us for a purpose.
It evades Phyrexians by hiding in the spaces between seconds.

relations.note: Some view Domri's ascent as a sign of Ilharg's return.
relations.quote: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.
